The 2026-08-04 backlog recorded this candidate as blocked by a consent wall; the official help centre served the same facts without one.

The server repository is Apache-2.0 licensed; the organisation is based in the United Kingdom and lists maintainers @daveverwer and @finestructure. PackageList documents the inclusion requirements and states "There’s also no quality threshold. As long as the packages are valid and meet the requirements below, we will accept them." No sponsoring entity is named on the organisation page, so none is recorded.

name: G2
description: Software review and product-profile platform run by G2.com, Inc., where a vendor submits a product for a research-team eligibility check and then claims the resulting profile, and each review is moderated by a person before it is published.
bestFor: B2B software vendors who want a moderated, reviewed product profile
notRecommendedFor: Products still in alpha or beta
typicalApprovalTime: Claim requests receive final approval within 1–3 business days
reviewProcess: A product is submitted through a public form, checked by G2’s research team for eligibility and categorisation, and then claimed by the vendor. Every review is read by a member of the moderation team before publication, and reviewer identity is confirmed through a business email, LinkedIn or Google sign-in.
pros: Every review is read by a moderator before it is published
Reviewer identity is confirmed at sign-in and shown as a validated label
cons: No accessible official page states what a vendor listing costs
Does not accept business-to-consumer products or alpha and beta software
editorNotes: Verified 2026-08-04. company.g2.com names G2.com, Inc. as the operating entity. documentation.g2.com documents the listing route — submission at g2.com/products/new, a research-team eligibility and categorisation check, then a claim approved "within 1–3 business days" — and states "Every review is reviewed by a member of G2’s moderation team." The vendor pricing page documents how vendors publish their own product pricing, not what G2 charges vendors, and G2 does not publish its own vendor pricing. www.g2.com returns HTTP 403 to automated fetches.
